raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misconstrued the plant’s ultimate energy conversion goal, asserting it delivers kinetic energy to the grid and answering “B) chemical energy to kinetic energy.” Coal plants ultimately convert chemical energy to electrical energy (via thermal and kinetic intermediates), so the correct choice is B) chemical energy to electrical energy.
